card.name: Connecting words in old-style recipes and prose
card.fires_on: Small joining words and punctuation (in, of, the, commas, semicolons) inside old-fashioned run-on text, especially step-by-step recipe instructions. Also a few words in historical or religious narrative.

modes.label: Recipe steps
modes.description: Commas, semicolons, and small words between cooking instructions in an old recipe.
modes.example: strew some seasoningon, and so on till all the ingredients are in<<;>> strew the remainder of the seasoning on

modes.label: Historical narrative
modes.description: Linking or ordinal words in older historical or religious prose.
modes.example: Vishnu<< the>> Preserver, Siva the Transformer.

card.plain: It fires on little connecting words and punctuation in old-style recipes and historical prose, and does not mean much on its own.
